question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

NRT, JNP, FJL, BFH, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e820d3b929240a6899edfe169fae6274b430efad8398a93b2fd62313f534e356.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

Each letter in the sequence moves **-4** positions backward in the English alphabetical order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58c052470ad2c01d73a7235f396f7de85e34cfa7ef893001d9315e38c2bb83cb.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** “Option 2”.**
